evidence.title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards

summary: The EarthVerse project has released a new benchmark suite designed to evaluate AI scientific agents on tasks involving dynamic Earth system simulations and natural hazard scenarios. This effort aims to standardize performance measurement and accelerate research on AI tools for geoscience and disaster mitigation.
title: EarthVerse Introduces Benchmark for Scientific Agents in Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards
